title: DAY 3 — LESSON 6: COMMUNICATING CONCERNS TO THE RIGHT PERSON

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of communicating concerns to the right person?
options: To make sure everyone hears about the problem
To ensure the concern reaches someone who can appropriately address it

questions.prompt: You notice a treatment-room equipment problem. What should you do?
options: Report it promptly and follow appropriate safety procedures
Ignore it until a client complains

questions.prompt: A colleague tells you about suspected serious misconduct involving a supervisor. What is appropriate?
options: Share the story in the general staff group
Remain silent because the supervisor is senior
Use an appropriate alternative or higher-level reporting channel

questions.prompt: Which statement is the most constructive workplace report?
options: Room 2's air conditioner is not cooling, and a client is scheduled soon. Could we arrange an alternative?

questions.prompt: What should you do if a serious concern remains unresolved?
options: Follow up and escalate through an appropriate channel
Spread the issue to uninvolved colleagues
